headline: Visual Designer
tagline: Graphic designer specializing in high-volume marketing collateral, visual systems, and AI-assisted workflows for tech brands.

skills.label: Design & Branding
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production

skills.label: Workflow & Tools
skills.items: AI-assisted design workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly), Framer, Webflow, Miro, Notion, wireframing

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives spanning employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Managed print-ready file preparation including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Utilized AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and exploration.
Collaborated directly with HR and management stakeholders to maintain low revision cycles.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Created logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses and startups.
Designed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for SMB clients.
Conducted usability testing and fed findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Produced wireframes and prototypes for digital products.
Partnered with developers and stakeholders to ensure smooth design-to-development handoff.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator to craft product visuals and marketing assets.

projects.name: Bounceless
bullets: Executed a B2B UX case study focused on building a cleaner verification experience for teams depending on accurate email lists, translating complex tech concepts into clear visual interfaces.

projects.name: Fashion Brand Social Campaign
bullets: Designed an Instagram and Facebook series that generated a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her high-volume marketing collateral experience, brand building, AI tooling familiarity from Ascent, and her ability to translate complex tech concepts into visual stories via the Bounceless project.
